notes.title: MUTANT COLLEGE IS RELEASING NOW!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!!!
We are excited to announce that Mutant College has just been released! We can't wait to share with you the result of this incredible journey.

In a world where 0.003% of the global population possesses mutant powers, attending a college for superheroes could be the opportunity of a lifetime—will you seize it? Mutant College is an adult visual novel that will immerse you in unique, thrilling, and engaging erotic experiences!

notes.title: Mutant College: my next game is coming soon!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Many of you have asked for information about my new project, so here I am, sharing a few details about Mutant College:

Mutant College will be a much larger game compared to Criminal Attraction and Mech Academy. First of all, there will be many more girls to develop relationships with—around 15. Each one, of course, has her own personality, desires, and kinks. Given the scale of the story and environments, I’ve decided to manage everything with a sandbox. I know what you’re thinking: “sandbox = grinding.” Absolutely not. The sandbox will be set up so that the gameplay and story are never slow or boring—trust me!

As for the story: you’ll live an adventure in the shoes of a mutant who has only recently discovered his powers. He finds himself attending Mutant College and, as tradition goes, every girl he meets will fall at his feet :). Mutant College won’t just let you experience a series of erotic adventures—a captivating underlying story will tie events together throughout. The MC will see his power grow to the point where he’ll have the potential to become a true hero.

The Steam page is already up! If you like the idea and want to support the development, add it to your wishlist—it will help me a lot to gauge your interest.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3291310/Mutant_College/]STEAM PAGE[/url]

Thank you all so much for the support you’ve given me over the years. None of this would be possible without you!

notes.title: Criminal Attraction: Emily
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841826/20c0197ac19aac4280588e5969127e1887c6fb00.png[/img]
Emily has been on the case of the cosplay gang for six months. They are four bank robbers. Emily is desperate because she can't make progress with the investigation. It's also the fault of her colleagues who don't give her the slightest support. Emily has a theory; she believes the robbers are masseuses. However, no one wants to listen to her. So when MC arrives at the FBI offices and is put to deal with a pile of paperwork, Emily, who has read his resume and knows what he's worth, decides to try to involve him in the investigation. MC gladly accepts.
Very serious and professional. Determined. She has no social life. Smart (a bit like Hermione). Talkative. Argumentative. She has made her job her life. Her colleagues don't look kindly on her; they have a certain disdain for her and tease her. She comes from a military family. Her father is a high-ranking general in the Marine Corps. Some consider her to be well-connected. She was raised as if she were a soldier, always dutiful and ready to sacrifice anything to complete the mission.
Emily has no intention of having a relationship with anyone, least of all with MC. Will you be able to change her mind?

notes.title: Criminal Attraction: Imelda
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841826/6083b63616ac4c19f1d95a1026e24bba6cbefc4a.png[/img]
Older sister of Monique. Imelda married at a very young age to a wealthy businessman: Lester Renner. Lester was a very possessive man, and Imelda was essentially a prisoner in the house where she lived. Despite this, she manages to earn a degree in medicine and surgery, although she cannot practice the profession for several years. Imelda also tries to divorce, but Lester threatens her life and persuades her to desist. Then, six years ago, comes the stroke of luck: Lester has a heart attack and dies. Imelda inherits only the house and a wellness center from Lester's properties. Lester had accumulated many debts. Imelda sells all the companies and properties to repay the debts. From that day on, Imelda decides she must change her life. She goes to a war zone as a volunteer doctor and there she meets Amina.
Imelda is a strong and determined woman. Endowed with great wisdom and foresight. Very cautious, she always makes the best decisions for everyone. Patient and tolerant. She is confident in herself. She never gets angry or nervous. She has great self-control even in the most dangerous situations. She is excellent at analyzing everything, every situation, every person. She is the confidante of all the girls in the gang. She has a natural gift for judging people, a sort of sixth sense that she never gets wrong.
Imelda wants a man different from her husband. Someone who allows her to be herself. Someone who knows how to share her life and appreciates her for who she is, strengths and weaknesses. Someone who is present in her life, caring, and never neglects her.
Imelda hides a terrible secret.

notes.title: Criminal Attraction: Monique
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841826/d8a655a1efcbe2706c19a04f92147740d2744a16.png[/img]

Younger sister of Imelda. She studied theater and acting and had many minor roles in some television series. Her career was on the rise until it was abruptly halted following her refusal to engage sexually with a producer in exchange for a leading role. Since that day, Monique has encountered only closed doors. She begins a path as a scam artist, leveraging her acting skills and disguises. Throughout this time, she remains in constant contact with her older sister.

Monique is the intellectual of the group, highly educated, she reads extensively. She has traveled extensively. She doesn't trust people much, fearing they might always deceive or betray her. She enjoys when her merits are recognized, likes receiving compliments. She also enjoys boasting, even though she knows it might make her seem unpleasant, although she doesn't worry about it much. She doesn't care much about others' judgment of her. She plans the bank heists. She's terrible with weapons, has poor aim, yet she always uses assault rifles. Monique tends to protect the other girls in the gang. She can be somewhat intrusive in their lives, especially in Amina's life. Monique considers Amina an irresponsible loose cannon, yet she cares deeply for her.

notes.title: Criminal Attraction: Cordelia
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841826/e6eaf524f7414e18d1c94f6871b71103fab75ddf.png[/img]

Cordelia has always been a very sharp girl, knowledgeable in technology, and passionate about martial arts. Her life is disrupted because of her father. Cordelia killed her father in self-defense. Cordelia's father was a violent and always drunk man. One night, he killed Cordelia's mother during yet another act of domestic violence, then turned towards his daughter, and only by a miracle did Cordelia prevail. Following this trauma, Cordelia was hospitalized in a psychiatric hospital. From that event, Cordelia developed severe psychological trauma. She can barely speak, has communication and socialization problems, and is afraid of all men. Three years ago, she was assaulted by another patient inside the clinic, suffered very serious injuries, and was taken to an emergency room. There she meets Imelda. Imelda treats her and then asks to take her into foster care. Cordelia resumes studying martial arts and becomes passionate about computer science and hacking. However, she continues to distrust people and has no contact with anyone except for the girls in the gang, particularly Imelda, whom she considers as a mother. Cordelia only feels at ease during bank robberies.

notes.title: Criminal Attraction: Amina
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841826/d44dc16f895dd0e0244692fe0d20391735bb0a1a.png[/img]
Amina.
The daggers are her favorite weapons, but she is skilled with explosives too. Amina has worked as a mercenary in some war zones, and in one of them, she met Imelda. Amina's entire family is a family of mercenaries. She has never lived like other girls. She has never dated boys, never had a boyfriend, and never even attended school. Her world has always been that of war. Despite her soldier past, Amina has a sweet, kind, carefree, and chatty nature (she loves telling anecdotes). She is the youngest in the group. She is clever and intelligent, but not when it comes to feelings. Beware, because she is partially aware of her sentimental naivety, but she's fine with it since she enjoys being courted and desired. She drinks beer and is passionate about engines. Having lived through the horrors of war, knowing the worst of human nature (she has seen a brother and many friends die), she always takes everything lightly, trivializes everything; for her, there are no problems or dramas. She plays down everything and does it sincerely. She loves meeting "normal" people and is curious about everything that others consider normal to know. She likes witty boys, even when the jokes are stupid, but they amuse her precisely because they are stupid jokes.

notes.title: Criminal Attraction
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841826/a70944da9186a19cda2138bae13849594f912bd3.jpg[/img]
I am happy to announce that, in June, I will release a new story: Criminal Attraction.
In this adult visual novel, you will play a wily agent whose job is to arrest 4 charming female bank robbers. 
Incriminating them will not be easy.
Right from the start you will be fascinated by their personalities and charisma: will you be able to stay true to your oath?

The demo of Criminal Attraction is now available for download.
I look forward to your feedback and criticism of my new work.
Enjoy!
